name: Chompy
personality: Chompy the Alligator. Dim, lazy, loves football. Always wears a football jersey.

arrival.text: Uhh, hi. Is this the restaurant? ...It is? Nice. I'm Chompy. What's your name? ...[name]. Cool. I'll try to remember that.
Hey, [name]! Wait. It's [name], right? Yeah. I knew that.
Yo! Is the patio open? I like the patio. It's like outside but with food.
I walked here. It took forever. Like, five whole minutes.
Game's on later. Gotta fuel up. That's what the pros say. I think.
Can I sit by the window? I'll just pretend it's the patio.
I dreamed about your breakfast last night. Then I woke up and I was hungry. True story.
Last time it was kinda crunchy. I like crunchy though. I think.
It's GAME DAY, [name]! ...Every day is game day if you think about it.

order.text: Uhh. Okay. I'm gonna read the whole menu. ...Okay, I read the first part.

choices.text: Take your time, Chompy. No rush.
choices.reply: Thanks, [name]. You're like a good coach. Big Breakfast, please.

choices.text: Want me to read it to you like a bedtime story?
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Ha! Yeah! ...Wait, would you actually do that?

choices.text: It's not that long. Just pick.
choices.reply: Huh? ...Oh. Ohh. Okay. The [dish]. (He doesn't look up.)

order.text: Do you have a football special? Like, food shaped like a football?

choices.text: Not yet, but I'll think about it, just for you.
choices.reply: For real? You're the best. I'll get the [dish] for now.

choices.text: The pancakes are round. That's half a football.

choices.reply: Yeah, that's the one. That's my play.
(He thinks about it for a long time.) ...Yeah. Probably.

order.text: You like my jersey? I got a new one. It's the same as the old one but new.

choices.text: Looks great on you. Very you.
choices.reply: (Puffs his chest out.) Thanks! I wear it to sleep too.

choices.text: Do you even own a shirt without a number?
choices.reply: ...Huh. No. Wait, do people do that?
The [dish]. Same as always. Like my jersey.

drink.fallback: Do you have Gator Goo? No? Uhh... whatever's green.
favourite: Gator Goo, please. It's got electrolytes. I don't know what those are but I need them.
drink.other: Surprise me. Not too surprising though.

perfect.text: WHOA. Touchdown! That's a touchdown plate, [name].

burnt.text: It's kinda black. That's the team colour though, so it's fine.

eating.text: Mmmf. Sorry. Mouth full. ...Still full. Okay, what's up?
You ever think about how eggs are just chickens that didn't happen? ...Wait, don't tell me. I don't wanna know.
If I eat really slow, I can stay longer. That's strategy.
I'm gonna nap after this. Not here. Probably.
(His head nods, then snaps up.) I'm up! I'm up.

eating_chat.text: Hey [name], who's your team? Like, football team.

choices.reply: Yesss! We're a team now. Team Chompy.
(Laughs way too hard.) Undefeated! Ha! ...Wait, who do you play?
That's okay. More football for me.
(He stares at his plate.) ...You take that back. ...Please.

leaving.text: That was a win. Big win. See ya, [name].
Okay, I gotta go do... nothing. It's a lot of work.
Bye! Wait, did I pay? ...I paid. Okay. Bye!

seasons.autumn: It's football season! It's always football season but now it's REALLY football season.
seasons.christmas: I asked for a new jersey. I'm gonna get a jersey. I can feel it.
seasons.halloween: I dressed up as a football player. (He's wearing his usual jersey.)
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to do less. Wait, is that possible?
seasons.summer: Patio season, baby. I'm gonna live out here.
seasons.winter: It's cold. Alligators don't like cold. I'm wearing two jerseys.
